name: Flat base
description: This screen looks for a stock that has gone sideways in a narrow band, close to its highs, without giving much back. A flat base is the shallowest of the pauses on this site: the whole point is that very little happened. It has to be level as well as shallow — a shelf that drifts steadily lower through its own span is a slow decline, not a rest, so that is measured separately and excluded. As with every screen here, the shape is a way of describing and timing a stock, not a forecast.
